svg.text: DUSTLINGS / A SMALL WORLD WITH ROOM FOR YOU
Art direction 01 • hypotheses for matched gameplay review • Bellwether opening • 10 September 2026
Quality reference: Sky — luminous depth, clear silhouettes, graceful timing. Original Dustlings shapes and identity.
MEET / the person beyond the task
Soft cut stone; hand-set joints; rounded joinery.
Friendly face, readable hands, stable foot soles.
Keep roofs and props clear of faces and doorways.
Warm attention in a cooler garden surround.
Plaster: broad matte. Stone: quiet mineral grain.
Wood: directional grain. Cloth: soft, no hard shine.
Weight shifts over a planted foot; no idle bobbing.
Notice → orient → gesture → settle back to work.
Protect dust curl and moth / helper contact.
No camera sweep required to see the reward.
WORKING PALETTE / KEEP CREAM, SAGE AND CLAY; SEPARATE THEIR VALUES
FIRST REPRESENTATIVE LOCATION: ARRIVAL LANE + LANTERN + IVO MEETING
Compare the same route at 1280×800, 52° FOV, 7.6 m camera; add deliberate orbit and interrupted turns.
Three priorities: visible discovery continuity; individual resident acting; arrival light / material hierarchy.
Preserve readable birth, grounded proportions, stable controls, paper UI and restrained companion light.
Board is a target, not proof. Actual moving gameplay and human review determine whether it works. Figma unavailable.
